original_test_intent: Assess GPU memory health through DCGM's page-retirement and row-remap checks while preserving and comparing persistent ECC, retirement and remap state before and after the level-4 run.
original_method: Identify each GPU and capture volatile/aggregate ECC, pending/retired pages, row-remap histogram/status and XIDs without resets; verify vendor semantics and whether the diagnostic can trigger remediation; preserve logs; start DCGM correctly, enable approved persistence, run one monitored level-4 suite, compare deltas and escalate any new degradation.
manual_activity: GPU reliability owner approves retirement/remap thresholds, expected diagnostic effects and disposition of new ECC/XID evidence; lab operator owns isolation, monitoring and service/persistence recovery.
required_inputs: Per-GPU baseline counters, reasons and thresholds
Whether level-4 may trigger persistent remediation
Isolation, OOB, monitoring and recovery plan
safety_requirements: Never clear or reset memory-health evidence
Preserve full diagnostic and ECC/XID logs
Monitor thermals, power and GPU availability
Stop on new persistent fault and never auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Validate semantics, diagnostic effects and approval
Restore runtime state and report without DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Classify new faults and set verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The generic suite invocation cannot establish persistent memory-health acceptance, conflicts on level and discards most output.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Start the approved service, capture all per-GPU ECC/retirement/remap state, then run full level 4 once without counter reset and re-read the same fields.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Level 4, persistence setting, 120-minute allocation and every-subtest criterion are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use immutable per-GPU before/after counters and reasons to distinguish pre-existing degradation, newly exposed fault and diagnostic-triggered remediation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds persistent-state oracle, no-reset rule, per-GPU attribution and fault escalation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A generic PASS cannot erase or override a new retired page, failed remap or ECC/XID delta.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some remediation is persistent and a newly exposed fault may require vendor quarantine rather than retry.

project_override_considerations: Reliability engineering must publish acceptable retirement/remap status and delta thresholds for each GPU generation, including whether any pending row or new retirement is automatic FAIL/BLOCKED.
expected_evidence: Pre/post ECC, retired/pending page and row-remap state with reasons
Complete level-4 output and per-subtest results
Final GPU/service/persistence health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source starts service after diagnostic execution, DeepSeek requests level-1 evidence for the level-4 command, and the generic criterion omits persistent page-retirement/row-remap state required by the title.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review is complete; execution blocks if memory-health semantics, diagnostic mutation behavior, recovery, compatible tooling or safe isolation cannot be established.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row358 Wistron-NV GPU-00351-V002: approve per-GPU page-retirement/row-remap/ECC/XID fields and thresholds, whether level-4 may trigger persistent remediation, handling of new deltas, service-first order, source level-4 over DeepSeek level-1, no-reset evidence and vendor recovery.

review_improvement: Adds the persistent memory-health state that determines whether the named retirement/remap check actually passed and protects that evidence from clearing.
independent_technical_reasoning: Retired pages and row-remap outcomes outlive the diagnostic process, so the decisive evidence is the per-GPU state transition and reason codes, not only a transient suite status. A new remap or ECC delta can be a hardware degradation even if the plugin reports success, and resetting counters would destroy that distinction.
